sources.title: Abingdon battery storage scheme submitted to Vale of White Horse planners
paragraphs: A major battery storage application near the Drayton substation outside Abingdon has prompted representations from neighbors concerned with potential fire safety hazards and battery thermal runaway in proximity to agricultural land.

Local environmental advocates expressed support for the project, emphasizing that regional battery infrastructure is essential to connect Thames Valley solar installations directly into the 33kV distribution network.
